issues.claim: `SortedSet<T>` построен на сбалансированном двоичном дереве (красно-чёрном) ... результат 0 означает для него «такой элемент уже есть»
issues.problem: The fetched excerpt of the SortedSet<T> page only shows "Duplicate elements are not allowed". It does not show that a comparer result of 0 means a duplicate, that the structure is a red-black tree, or the SortedDictionary/SortedList behaviour on `Add` and the indexer. The claims are true and the sandbox confirms `2 c,aa`, but the cited sources do not state them explicitly.
issues.suggestedFix: Optionally add links to SortedSet<T>.Add, SortedDictionary<TKey,TValue>.Add and SortedList<TKey,TValue>.Add, or soften the red-black-tree wording to "a balanced binary search tree".

issues.problem: The RU option text says "Исключение `ArgumentException`" while the EN text is only "`ArgumentException`". This is minor stylistic drift and not a factual difference.
issues.suggestedFix: Make the two texts parallel, for example "Исключение `ArgumentException`" and "`ArgumentException` is thrown", or use the bare type name in both.

issues.claim: What does the variable `items` actually hold - finished objects or a way to produce them? And what happens every time it is enumerated?
issues.problem: The hint, and also the title ("objects created with Select"), points very close to the answer: it names `items` and `Select` and describes re-enumeration. For a click-the-line question this nearly reveals line 2.
issues.suggestedFix: Make the title neutral, for example "Find the line that makes the Done flags get lost". Weaken the hint to "How many times does `new Item` run in this program?" in EN, and the same in RU.

issues.claim: Отложенное выполнение и ленивые вычисления в LINQ
issues.problem: The cited page is the LINQ to XML article. Its excerpt supports deferred execution in general but does not say that the projection runs again on every enumeration. That statement is supported by the CA1851 page, whose text includes "The enumeration result is not calculated once and cached".
issues.suggestedFix: Optionally add a link to the Enumerable.Select docs, whose remarks describe deferred execution, or note in the link title that the page is about LINQ to XML.
